Test vectors for the Noodle Extensions and lane-rotation tests (tests/noodle_maps_test.gd, and the
spawner, judging and play-frame tests that read them). Generated by the research's
`vectors/gen_noodle_vectors.py`, which restates the formulas of Noodle Extensions and Heck
(github.com/Aeroluna/Heck at 3bbcaf6733f6faa688a70b296b4d83c92c1f5dc8, MIT), the base game's lane
rotation (bs-cordl v4008 types, the BSMG wiki's "Spawn Rotations", Mapping Extensions'
360DegreeNoteRotationPatches.cs) and Unity's quaternion maths (behaviour only), and checks them
against closed forms. `rotation.json` also holds values read from two library files (That's Life
Expert360Degree, Golden Hour ExpertPlusStandard). Each file names its sources in its `source` key and
the scene values it assumes (`centerPos.z` 0.65, `jumpOffsetY` 0) in `scene_values_used`. Values are
doubles; the game runs in single precision, so compare with a tolerance of about 1e-5, and compare
positions relative to the hit plane, since Kenbu's is 0.9 m.
